definitions.explanation: A round bulb vegetable with layers, widely used in cooking. A staple ingredient in both Japanese and Western cuisine.

examples.japanese: {玉|たま}ねぎをみじん{切|ぎ}りにする。
{玉|たま}ねぎを{切|き}ると{涙|なみだ}が{出|で}る。
examples.english: My eyes water when I cut onions.

examples.japanese: カレーには{玉|たま}ねぎをたっぷり{入|い}れると{甘|あま}みが{出|で}ておいしい。
examples.english: Adding plenty of onions to curry brings out sweetness and makes it delicious.

notes:
USAGE:
Usually written {玉|たま}ねぎ in mixed script. The name comes from {玉|たま} (ball) + ねぎ (green onion), describing its round shape. Hokkaido is Japan's largest onion-producing region.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {玉|たま}ねぎを{炒|いた}める (to sauté onions)
- {玉|たま}ねぎのみじん{切|ぎ}り (minced onion)
- {新|しん}{玉|たま}ねぎ (new/spring onion — sweeter, milder variety)
